verdict.rationale: FFmpeg is a documented command-line tool that takes files, pipes and network streams as inputs, so it is inherently scriptable without a GUI. Community reports show it running in unattended automation: a live transcription pipeline that updates a website in real time, batch-file wrappers, and single-process motion detection. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on CI/headless use (non-interactive flags, exit-code semantics), and evidence of turnkey CI integration; users also report shell-escaping friction when building commands in scripts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: ffmpeg reads from an arbitrary number of inputs (which can be regular files, pipes, network streams, grabbing devices, etc.)
they use FFmpeg and Whisper to record and transcribe live police scanner audio for their city, updating a live website in real time
